buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Purchase Preference (State) Bid reserved for MSE from the State of Bid Inviting Authority: Procurement under this bid is reserved for purchase from Micro and Small Enterprises from the State of Bid Inviting Authority having valid Udyam Registration and whose credentials are validated online through Udyam Registration portal. If the bidder wants to avail themselves of the reservation benefit, the bidder must be the manufacturer / OEM of the offered product on GeM. Traders are excluded from the purview of Public Procurement Policy for Micro and Small Enterprises and hence resellers offering products manufactured by some other OEM are not eligible to participate in this bid. In respect of bid for Services, the bidder must be the Service provider of the offered Service. Relevant documentary evidence in this regard shall be uploaded along with the bid in respect of the offered product or service, and Buyer will decide eligibility based on documentary evidence submitted, while evaluating the bid. Benefits of MSE will be allowed only if seller is validated on-line in GeM profile as well as validated and approved by Buyer after evaluation of documents submitted. 3. Service & Support Availability of Service Centres: Bidder/OEM must have a Functional Service Centre in the State of each Consignee's Location in case of carry-in warranty. (Not applicable in case of goods having on-site warranty). If service center is not already there at the time of bidding, successful bidder / OEM shall have to establish one within 30 days of award of contract. Payment shall be released only after submission of documentary evidence of having Functional Service Centre. 4. Service & Support Dedicated /toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support : BIDDER/OEM must have Dedicated/toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support. 5. Service & Support Escalation Matrix For Service Support : Bidder/OEM must provide Escalation Matrix of Telephone Numbers for Service Support. 6. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 7. Certificates ISO 9001: The bidder or the OEM of the offered products must have ISO 9001 certification. 8. Certificates

Material Test Certificate Should Be Sent Along with The Supply. The Material Will Be Checked by Buyer’s Lab & the Results of the Lab will be the Sole Criteria for Acceptance of the Item. 9. Certificates The bidder is required to upload, along with the bid, all relevant certificates such as BIS licence, type test certificate, approval certificates and other certificates as prescribed in the Product Specification given in the bid document. 10. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Service Centre Within 70 KM The bidder/OEM must maintain an operational service centre within a radius of 70 kilometres from the inst allation location to provide timely installation support, maintenance, repairs, and after-sales service. The t ender should identify the installation location/reference point and the method for measuring the 70 km dist ance. Proof of Service Centre / Office Location The bidder must submit documentary proof of the declared service centre/office address. The submission must include the complete address, a Google Maps location/map evidence showing the route or distance fr om the installation location, and clear, recent photographs of the office/service centre. The Buyer may verify the location and supporting evidence. Service Centre and Service Engineer Contact Details The bidder must provide the service centre telephone/mobile number and the name, designation, and mob ile number of the responsible service engineer. The details must remain operational and be updated prom ptly if changed. OEM Details for Every Quoted Item For every individual item quoted in the bid, the bidder must clearly identify the respective OEM/manufactu rer and submit the required OEM authorization and product-specific supporting documents for that item. A general or blanket authorization should not be treated as covering multiple items unless it expressly lists t hem. EMD Compulsory - No Exemption (Subject to Applicable Rules) The bid must be accompanied by the EMD in the amount and form specified in the tender. Any exemption should be handled strictly in accordance with the procurement rules applicable to the Buyer and the tende r. A blanket denial of statutory or policy-based exemptions should not be inserted where such exemptions are mandatory. Physical Submission of EMD Before Deadline Where the tender requires physical submission of the EMD instrument/document, the bidder must deliver it to the designated office/address before the stated deadline. The tender must clearly specify the receiving office, accepted mode, required instrument, date, and exact cut-off time. Proof of dispatch alone should n ot be treated as proof of receipt unless the tender expressly allows it. Buyer’s Right to Accept or Reject Bids The Buyer reserves the right to accept or reject any bid, or all bids, in accordance with applicable procure ment rules and the terms of the tender. The Buyer shall follow applicable requirements relating to transpar

ency, recording of reasons, communication, and review; the clause should not purport to override mandato ry legal or procurement safeguards. Non-Compliant / Unrequested Documents In case of rejection, any document submitted or uploaded subsequently by the bidder shall not be conside red for evaluation and will not be accepted by the Technical Committee or the concerned Department. . 11.
